components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action button with TailAdmin electric indigo background.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 9px 18px; background-color: #465fff; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(70, 95, 255, 0.3); transition: all 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: #384dec; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(70, 95, 255, 0.4); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Cyan Action Button
components.description: Gradient action button for AI generation and audio transcription.
components.css: .ds-btn-cyan { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 9px 18px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #06b6d4 0%, #0891b2 100%); color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.3); transition: all 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-cyan:hover { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0891b2 0%, #0e7490 100%); box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.4); } .ds-btn-cyan:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Neutral border button for secondary or cancel actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 9px 18px; background-color: #ffffff; color: #101828; font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; border: 1px solid #d0d5dd; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background-color: #f6f8ff; border-color: #a5b4fc; color: #465fff; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Glass Container Card
components.description: Standard container card with specular hairline border and soft depth.
components.css: .ds-card { background-color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #eaecf0; border-radius: 16px; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0px 1px 3px 0px rgba(16, 24, 40, 0.1); font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-card:hover { border-color: #d0d5dd; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: #475467; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-card-val { font-size: 1.75rem; font-weight: 800; color: #101828; letter-spacing: -0.02em; }

components.name: Hot Intent Badge
components.description: Status pill badge for high-intent leads and critical alerts.
components.css: .ds-badge-hot { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; background-color: #fef3f2; color: #b42318; font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.3; }

components.name: Form Input Field
components.description: Standard form text input with indigo focus glow ring.
components.html: <input type="text" class="ds-input" placeholder="Search SaaS accounts or leads..." />
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 10px 14px; background-color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #d0d5dd; border-radius: 8px; color: #101828; font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; outline: none; transition: all 0.15s ease; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #465fff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(70, 95, 255, 0.15); }

components.name: Pulse Telemetry Indicator
components.description: Live status pulsing beacon indicating real-time background ML & audio processing.
components.css: .ds-pulse-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background-color: #12b76a; display: inline-block; box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(18, 183, 106, 0.7); animation: ds-pulse-ring 2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.6, 1) infinite; } @keyframes ds-pulse-ring { 0% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(18, 183, 106, 0.7); } 70% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 8px rgba(18, 183, 106, 0); } 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(18, 183, 106, 0); } }

narrative.overview:
SaaS SalesGenie AI is designed as a precision instrumentation cockpit for high-velocity B2B SaaS revenue teams. The visual language blends analytical clarity with deep volumetric dimension and glass surfaces. High-density metrics, real-time ML intent scoring, and dynamic outreach workflows are rendered with absolute structural hierarchy, ensuring that critical pipeline decisions can be made in sub-second glances.

The interface maintains a tailored dual-theme architecture: in Light Mode, crisp porcelain white surfaces (#ffffff) float on a soft slate ground (#f2f4f7); in Dark Mode, translucent midnight cards (rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03) on #0b1329) are framed by specular hairline borders (rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08) to 0.22), accented by electric indigo (#465fff) and aurora cyan (#06b6d4).
keyCharacteristics: Deep dimension and glass surface styling with specular hairline borders.
TailAdmin signature electric indigo primary brand and aurora cyan AI intelligence accents.
High-contrast dual-mode parity across Light and Dark themes.
Clear numeric typography pairing geometric Outfit headings with monospace JetBrains Mono telemetry.

rules.name: The Glass Depth Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Translucent glass surfaces require hairline specular borders (rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08) to 0.14) to preserve structural edge contrast without heavy opaque fills.

rules.name: The Intent Rarity Rule
rules.body: Vivid electric indigo and aurora cyan accents are reserved for active intelligence, actionable triggers, and state badges (≤15% total visual footprint per screen).

rules.name: The Numeric Scannability Rule
rules.body: All financial amounts ($ARR/ACV) and ML percentage scores must use high-contrast text weights (600–800) with tabular number alignment.

rules.name: The Flat-Rest Ambient-Active Rule
rules.body: Container cards remain flat at rest with hairline borders. Volumetric glow and border illumination appear strictly in response to user focus, hover, or active background ML processing.

dos: Do maintain strict visual parity and WCAG 2.1 AA contrast ratios across both Light and Dark themes.
Do frame dark mode glass surfaces with 1px specular borders (rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)) to preserve card boundaries.
Do format financial amounts and conversion metrics with Outfit 700+ weights and JetBrains Mono code tags.
Do provide instant visual feedback on interactive AI triggers (audio recording mic pulses, generating spinners).
donts: Don't use opaque muddy black #000000 backgrounds in dark mode; use rich midnight navy #0b1329.
Don't flood entire cards with saturated primary colors; keep vibrant indigo and cyan restricted to ≤15% of screen area.
Don't use heavy drop shadows without specular border definition on translucent card containers.
Don't omit units, timeframes, or trend indicators on executive KPI metric cards.
